collection.description: Odd footprints circle a hut overnight, and villagers disagree about Biggles.

premise.name: The premise
premise.text: Odd footprints circle a hut overnight. A hunter sees animal signs; a magician insists the pattern is too deliberate.

a.name: Answer A
a.text: They end at wet stone; no explanation survives the tide.

b.name: Answer B
b.text: The station records a small animal, but not the source of every footprint.

c.name: Answer C
c.text: The fruit disappears; a child later admits visiting the site, but denies taking it.

text_only.reason: an offering of fruit; no villager disappears
